piglet_pressure_diagnostic.reason: Observed low-noise pressure differs from external pressure in main anharmonic solid campaign
piglet_pressure_diagnostic.interpretation: Feedback uses actual centroid kinetic energy; replacing it by its canonical expectation is a separate diagnostic in a noncanonical PIGLET state.
piglet_pressure_diagnostic.balance_definition: mean(V*(p_feedback-p_ext)+1/beta), beta=5 and p_ext=1; stationary BZP target zero
piglet_pressure_diagnostic.assessment: The P=4 harmonic calibration fails this anharmonic solid pressure/transferability check: canonical-substituted pressure and centroid kinetic ratio exclude their targets at both timesteps. This establishes an estimator-substitution discrepancy; it does not isolate the microscopic cause among noncanonical anharmonic energy transfer, finite beads and remaining sampling effects.
